timingLimitations: Native solveSeconds used for comparisons; process wall time includes I/O and up to 2s polling delay. Two observations do not establish statistical performance. Sequential local macOS runs only.

monitor.source:
import json, resource, shutil, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path

try:
    import psutil
except Exception:
    psutil = None

if len(sys.argv) not in (3,4): raise SystemExit('usage: run_one.py method output-dir [full]')
method = sys.argv[1]; root = Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve(); root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
full = len(sys.argv)==4 and sys.argv[3]=='full'
mesh = Path('outputs/native-flow/sst-normal-refinement/midpoint/mesh.cm2d').resolve(); prefix = root/'flow'
cmd=[str(Path.cwd()/'build/cartmesh2d_sst_rans_probe'),str(mesh),str(prefix),'flatplate-sweep','--nu','2e-7','--speed','1','--inlet-k','2.25e-7','--inlet-omega','125','--leading-edge','0','--max-iterations',('20000' if full else '100'),'--max-seconds',('540' if full else '90'),'--completion-updates','500','--scalar-preconditioner','ilu0','--pressure-preconditioner',method]
start=time.monotonic(); samples=[]; timeout=False; disk_floor=int(1.5*1024**3); rss_limit=512*1024*1024
with (root/'stdout.log').open('wb') as out,(root/'stderr.log').open('wb') as err:
    p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdout=out,stderr=err); proc=psutil.Process(p.pid) if psutil else None
    while True:
        rc=p.poll(); elapsed=time.monotonic()-start; rss=None
        if proc:
            try:rss=proc.memory_info().rss
            except psutil.Error:rss=None
        free=shutil.disk_usage(root).free; samples.append({'elapsedSeconds':elapsed,'rssBytes':rss,'diskFreeBytes':free})
        if free<disk_floor or (rss is not None and rss>rss_limit):p.kill();p.wait();rc=p.returncode;break
        if rc is not None:break
        if elapsed>=(600 if full else 120):timeout=True;p.kill();p.wait();rc=p.returncode;break
        time.sleep(2)
end=time.monotonic(); child_rss=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss
result={'method':method,'command':cmd,'runtimeSeconds':end-start,'exitCode':rc,'timeout':timeout,'peakRssBytes':child_rss,'peakRssSource':'resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN.ru_maxrss','liveRssGuardActive':psutil is not None,'rssLimitBytes':rss_limit,'diskFloorBytes':disk_floor,'samples':samples}
(root/'runtime.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
sys.exit(124 if timeout else (rc if rc is not None else 1))

fullComparison.scope: One earlier IC0 full solve and one new aggregation full solve; same mesh/physics/initial values/tolerances/core numerical code. Not paired repeated full-run timing.
